text: Khem Singh Bedi Haveli Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Khem Singh Bedi Haveli Type: Monument - Haveli Province: Punjab District: Rawalpindi Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1857 - 1947 CE Description: The haveli of Khem Singh Bedi is measuring 18x18x15m. It is a three storey building with 22 rooms (4x3.5m each), verandas (31x18m), courtyards (9.6x9.6m) and basements. Rooms are provided with oriels (jharokha). The most attractive features of the haveli are fresco paintings, which cover the facade and pillars of verandas and interior of the rooms. The paintings are in good condition and haveli is in well preserved condition.
